To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the electrical and thermal transport properties of double filled and iron substituted p-type skutterudeite antimonides have been studied in order to determine the effects of the filling fraction and iron substitution on the transport properties of these materials.
the thermal conductivity of Yb and Fe substituted p-type skutterudes decreases with increasing temperature up until 700 K, and the maximum ZT value is 0.6 for Yb0.38In0.018 Co2.4Fe 1.6Sbn2 at 760 K.

the transport properties of Yb and Fe substituted p-type skutterudeites are strongly dependent on temperature, and that Yb0.4In0.018Fe0.8Co2.4Sb12 exhibits the largest thermoelectric efficiency at high temperatures.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the synthesis of Yb and/or In double-filled and Co and/or Fe substituted p-type skutterudeites and the investigation of their transport properties.
the synthesis, characterization, and transport properties of p-type double filled skutterudite compounds.
the synthesis and characterization of double-filled skutterudite compounds with a low filling fraction.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the double-filled skutterudites are not suitable as thermoelectric materials for high-temperature thermoelectric applications.
the transport properties of double-filled and Fe-substituted skutterudite compounds were not as good as the single-filled skutterudites.
the transport properties of double-filled skutterudites can be tuned by the choice of filling fraction and filling element.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Yb and In filled p-type skutterudeite compounds have the potential for thermoelectric applications.

the double filling of Yb and/or In into p-type skutterudeites can be used to improve the thermoelectric figure of merit, but the enhancement is limited to the temperature region where the bipolar conduction can be ignored.
the double-filled skutterudites are good candidates for thermoelectric materials.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the transport properties of Yb and Fe substituted skutterudites are similar to those of the Yb0,4Co4Sb12 skutterudite.

the transport properties of the double filled skutterudites are strongly influenced by the filling fraction, the nature of the filling atom, and the amount of substitution of the transition metal atoms.
the transport properties of the double-filled Yb-In skutterudites are comparable to those of other filled skutterudites.
